meta.title: 一张图看懂直方图：摄影影调的秘密
meta.title_en: Understanding the Histogram: The Secret to Photo Tones

scenes.context: 讲者用像素分阶演示直方图原理：最暗到最亮分11份，中性灰居中，像素从左到右排列。
sentences: 这是一张普通的数码照片，给它做一个像素分阶处理。
Take an ordinary digital photo and split its pixels into graded steps.
像素分阶：graded pixel steps
从最暗到最亮的中间部分为中性灰。
The middle between darkest and brightest is neutral gray.
中性灰：neutral gray
把每个像素块从最暗到最亮从左到右排开，这就是直方图的显示原理。
Line the pixels up from darkest to brightest, left to right — that's how a histogram works.
直方图：histogram
paraphrase: A histogram is a map of your pixels' brightness.
Neutral gray is the center of tone.
scenes.speak: Take an ordinary digital photo and split its pixels into graded steps. The middle between darkest and brightest is neutral gray. Line the pixels up from darkest to brightest, left to right — that's how a histogram works.

scenes.context: 讲者讲解曝光、黑色、阴影、高光、白色五组参数对像素分布的不同影响。
sentences: 降低曝光，所有像素向暗部靠近；提高曝光，所有像素向亮部靠近。
Lower the exposure and all pixels shift toward the shadows; raise it and they shift toward the highlights.
曝光：exposure
修改黑色参数，最暗的部分改变最多。
Adjusting blacks changes the darkest areas the most.
黑色参数：blacks
修改阴影改暗部，修改高光改亮部，修改白色改最亮的部分。
Shadows tweak the dark zones, highlights tweak the bright zones, and whites tweak the brightest parts.
阴影/高光/白色：shadows/highlights/whites
paraphrase: Each control's name tells you which zone it affects.
曝光是全局，其余是局部
Exposure is global; the rest are local.
scenes.speak: Lower the exposure and all pixels shift toward the shadows; raise it and they shift toward the highlights. Adjusting blacks changes the darkest areas the most. Shadows tweak the dark zones, highlights tweak the bright zones, and whites tweak the brightest parts.

scenes.context: 讲者点明对比度以中性灰为轴，并用概念指导影调风格调整。
sentences: 对比度是以中性灰作为界限。
Contrast pivots on neutral gray as its axis.
作为界限：pivot on
提高对比度，让亮部更亮、暗部更暗。
More contrast makes highlights brighter and shadows darker.
提高对比度：more contrast
降低对比度，让暗部变亮、让亮部变暗。
Less contrast brightens the shadows and softens the highlights.
影调风格：tonal style
paraphrase: Contrast widens or narrows the gap between light and dark.
Your tonal style is set by this light-dark axis.
scenes.speak: Contrast pivots on neutral gray as its axis. More contrast makes highlights brighter and shadows darker. Less contrast brightens the shadows and softens the highlights.

practice: Line the pixels up from darkest to brightest.
Adjust the shadows to bring out dark detail.
Pull the highlights down to recover detail.
Boost the contrast for a punchier look.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Do a pixel-level segmentation process.
✓ 地道说法：Split its pixels into graded steps.
分阶处理→graded steps，更贴近画面意思。
黑色参数在后期软件里就叫 blacks。
✕ 直译腔：Contrast uses neutral gray as the line.
✓ 地道说法：Contrast pivots on neutral gray.
✕ 直译腔：The bright part becomes brighter.
✓ 地道说法：The highlights get brighter.
shifts: 按参数对应的亮度区间分别调整
把对比度当整体变暗变亮
以中性灰为轴理解对比度
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「像素号分割处理」校正为「像素分阶处理」、「指方图」校正为「直方图」、「中性灰」为摄影术语保留；视频为极简讲解型口播，专有名词（exposure、shadows、highlights）保留英文语义。
